title: fix(console): invitation refusals read in the console's language

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:组织邀请链路上的两个报错改成控制台自己的语言。打开失效的邀请链接时不再显示 better-auth 的英文 "Invitation not found!",而是「该邀请已被使用、已过期或已撤销。如果您已接受过该邀请,可在组织列表中找到该组织。」;邀请一个已经是成员的人时显示「该用户已是本组织成员。」。共 11 种语言。
- 为什么改:better-auth 的 `get-invitation` 对「找不到」只回 400 加一句英文,不带错误码,控制台按错误码翻译所以漏掉了;「已是成员」这个错误码也没有映射。已接受过的邀请再打开,服务端的回答和「找不到」完全一样,控制台无法区分,所以改为在同一句话里说明「可能已被使用」并指向组织列表(页面原有的「前往组织」按钮)。
- 风险与回滚:只认「`get-invitation` + 400 + 无错误码」这一种回答,不读英文原文;其他 400(带错误码的)和 401 等仍照旧显示服务端原句。`@object-ui/auth` 抛出的错误多带一个 `status` 字段,原有字段与文字不变。服务端不改。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/orgErrorMessage.ts` 的 `resolveInvitationLookupMessage`;`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` 的 `toAuthError` 一行;`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts` 的两句中文。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/invitationVendorRefusals-33650.test.tsx`,预期 9 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The invitation lookup's code-less not-found reads as the console's sentence.** better-auth 1.7.12 `GET /organization/get-invitation` (`dist/plugins/organization/routes/crud-invites.mjs`, `getInvitation`) throws `APIError.fromStatus("BAD_REQUEST", { message: "Invitation not found!" })` with no `code` for an unknown id and for an invitation that is accepted, rejected, canceled or expired. Every other 400 the route answers names its code (`ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND`, `INVITER_IS_NO_LONGER_A_MEMBER_OF_THE_ORGANIZATION`, better-call's `VALIDATION_ERROR`). The new `resolveInvitationLookupMessage` (orgErrorMessage.ts) reads exactly that answer, keyed on the route (only `AcceptInvitationPage`'s `getInvitation` catch calls it), status 400 and the missing code, and never on the English text (the module's rule, objectui#4474). Anything else goes through `resolveOrgErrorMessage` as before.
- **`@object-ui/auth` carries the HTTP status.** `toAuthError` dropped `status`, so the page could not see the 400. It now copies a numeric `status` onto the thrown error, like the two-factor and invitation-preview errors in the same file already do. `message`, `code` and the rest are unchanged. `AuthClientError` is a module-internal type; no exported type changes.
- **`USER_IS_ALREADY_A_MEMBER_OF_THIS_ORGANIZATION` joins `ORG_ERROR_MESSAGE_KEYS`** as `organization.errors.alreadyMember`, with a sentence in all 11 packs (10 hand-written, `zh-Hant` generated by `gen:zh-hant`).
- **The not-found sentence names every state the server folds into it** ("already been used, has expired, or was revoked") and tells an invitee who accepted where the organization is. The error card already carries the "Go to organizations" button, which is the way in.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/invitationVendorRefusals-33650.test.tsx` (new, 9 cases): the REAL `AcceptInvitationPage` and `InviteMemberDialog` under the real `I18nProvider`, with `useAuth` forwarding to the REAL `createAuthClient` over a stubbed `fetch` that answers better-auth 1.7.12's own bodies. Faces 1 (zh and en), 2 and 3, the pack census for the new key, and four CONTROLs: a coded 400 from get-invitation keeps its own message; a code-less 401 keeps its own message; `accept-invitation`'s coded `INVITATION_NOT_FOUND` still maps as before; an unmapped coded invite refusal keeps the server's sentence.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/authErrorStatus-33650.test.ts` (new, 2 cases): the real client carries `status` on a code-less and on a coded refusal, message unchanged.
- `orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts`: the mapping-table census names the new code.

## Acceptance notes

- **Face 3 is worded, not detected.** The id alone cannot tell an accepted invitation from an unknown one: get-invitation refuses any status but `pending` with the same code-less 400, `list-user-invitations` filters to `pending`, and objectstack's signed-out `invitation-preview` answers one uniform 404 by design (ADR-0138 D2). The console could only find the invitation by listing invitations of every organization the user belongs to (`list-invitations` returns all statuses to a member), which is new fan-out fetching, not data the page already has, so the order's fallback applies: the sentence covers used / expired / revoked and points to the organization list. A server answer that tells a signed-in recipient "you already accepted this, organization X" is reported for a server card.
- **Clause-② is `yes (widening)`** (seat reading, as for PR #33485 and PR #33585): `@object-ui/i18n` gains `organization.errors.alreadyMember` in all eleven locale packs (and rewords `organization.errors.invitationNotFound`), and errors thrown by `@object-ui/auth` gain a numeric `status` property beside `message` and `code`. Nothing is removed or narrowed; no exported type changes (`AuthClientError` is module-internal).
- `resolveInvitationLookupMessage` is a separate entry point rather than a status rule inside `resolveOrgErrorMessage`: only the caller knows which route it called, and a code-less 400 from another organization route is not a not-found.

## Verification

All local readings at head `2c555217` (the later head only changes the changeset's declaration line and prose; the changeset gates were rerun on it: check-changeset-no-major, check-empty-changeset, check-adr-0087-registration and its self-test, changeset-gate-self-tests, nul-bytes, all exit 0) (base `3c0033f9`; `origin/main` has moved 20 commits since, none touching these files).

<details><summary>Measurement on base: all three faces reproduce</summary>

Production sources put back to `3c0033f9` (tests kept), the new pins run, then `git checkout HEAD --` restored (`git diff HEAD` empty):

```
× getInvitation: the code-less not-found carries status 400 and no code   (expected undefined to be 400)
× inviteMember: a coded refusal carries its status beside the code
× zh: draws the localized not-found sentence, not the vendor's English    (Received: Invitation not found!)
× en: draws the console's own English sentence, not the vendor's          (Received: Invitation not found!)
× reads as used / expired / revoked and points to the organization list   (Received: "Invitation not found!")
× zh: the invite dialog draws the localized sentence                      (Received: User is already a member of this organization)
× organization.errors.alreadyMember is a translated string in each pack   (en: undefined)
Tests  7 failed | 4 passed (11)    the 4 passing are the CONTROLs
```

Deciding lines on base: face 1 and 3, `orgErrorMessage.ts:191` (`resolveOrgErrorMessage` returns the non-empty message verbatim because the error has no code) behind `createAuthClient.ts:195` (`toAuthError` keeps `code`, drops `status`), called from `AcceptInvitationPage.tsx:84`; face 2, `ORG_ERROR_MESSAGE_KEYS` has no `USER_IS_ALREADY_A_MEMBER_OF_THIS_ORGANIZATION` row (invite section, `orgErrorMessage.ts:89-100`). Face 3 is the same wire answer as face 1: better-auth refuses any status but `pending` with the code-less 400.
</details>
